key.name: mode
key.description: hide = hide the overlay while sharing; keep = never hide (use for the negative-control test); off = do nothing.

key.name: app-ids
key.description: Matched (case-insensitively) against the window's GTK application id, sandboxed app id, WM_CLASS and WM_CLASS instance.

key.name: keep-above
key.summary: Pin the overlay on top and on all workspaces
key.description: Wayland clients cannot raise or stick their own windows; the Shell extension does it for them.
